test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: TRIFED was established in 1987 under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs to:

options.text: provide financial aid to tribal individuals
promote industrial development in tribal areas
facilitate the marketing of tribal products and empower tribal people
promote the education of tribal children

solution:
The correct answer is __**facilitate the marketing of tribal products and empower tribal people**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **TRIFED** (Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India) was established in **1987** under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
 
• Its primary aim is to **facilitate the marketing of tribal products** and **empower tribal people** by improving their income and livelihood opportunities.
 
• TRIFED promotes tribal products by organizing exhibitions, fairs, and other marketing events to provide a platform for tribal artisans.
 
• The organization also engages in capacity-building activities to enhance the skills of tribal artisans and producers.
 
• TRIFED helps in the creation of sustainable economic opportunities for tribal communities by linking them with national and international markets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs:**

 
 
• The Ministry of Tribal Affairs was formed in 1999 to provide more focused attention on the integrated socio-economic development of Scheduled Tribes (STs).
 
• It is responsible for planning, policy formulation, and coordination of programs for the development of STs.
 
 
 
• **Van Dhan Vikas Kendra:**
 
 
• Initiative under TRIFED to promote value addition, branding, and marketing of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) by establishing Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs).
 
• It aims to provide livelihood opportunities to tribal gatherers and ensure fair prices for their produce.
 
 
 
• **GI Tag for Tribal Products:**
 
 
• TRIFED helps in obtaining Geographical Indication (GI) tags for tribal products to protect and promote unique tribal crafts and traditions.
 
• GI tagging helps in branding and marketing tribal products at higher prices, ensuring better income for tribal artisans.
 
 
 
• **Tribes India:**
 
 
• The retail arm of TRIFED, which markets tribal products through various outlets and e-commerce platforms.
 
• Tribes India promotes and sells a wide range of tribal products, including handicrafts, handlooms, and natural products.
